messages.subject: [relogit] The goodness-of-fit test
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

 

I understand Relogit is not a likelihood technique, so can?t perform the likelihood ratio test (LRT) like form the ordinary logit. But, are there any other ways of doing smething similar to that from Relogit; I simplely want to perform the goodness-of-fit test between two nested models.

 

Thanks all.

 

J.S.

messages.subject: [relogit] The goodness-of-fit test
messages.body_plain:
just to clarify, you're not really interested in the goodness of fit 
between the two nested models.  If you were, then logit would do better. 
relogit drops fit to reduce bias, which we normally care more about.

on fit, i'd look at calibration plots like that in 
http://gking.harvard.edu/files/abs/improv-abs.shtml and 
http://gking.harvard.edu/files/abs/toe-resp-abs.shtml

Gary
